title: Efreeti Bottle: remove-stopper hint and the first-opening/opening-counter outcomes
description: Found by eshyra-olc5.12.2. remove-stopper (printed action, spends the stopper pool, olc5.12.2) returns hint.bindGrant serving-efreeti for every spend, but the first opening is also a remove-stopper and the GM's d100 may roll hostile (01-10) or wish (91-00), which end the bottle's magic without a serving bind. The stopper then stays depleted with no timer, which is harmless only because the bottle has lost its magic. The hint text should not imply serving on non-serving outcomes. Still untyped and DM-adjudicated: the d100 first-opening roll (randomProcedure M8), the next-two-openings and fourth-opening escape counter, and bottle-loses-magic. Source: efreeti-bottle description and table:efreeti-bottle (magic-item:efreeti-bottle).
